featured_reviews.name: Kinnar Majithia
featured_reviews.review_text:
This review is first for the hospital and then for Dr Partha Sarathi.

Hospital - very clean, very good staff, very good doctors and support system, great processes. Car parking is a challenge, valet can get expensive for long hours and multiple days. Cafeteria ia great.
Nursing staff and ward boys are extremely friendly and cooperative.

Dr. Partha Sarathi
A few months back he successfully completed CABG for my father. While there are many surgeons who perform this, one thing that stands out with Dr. Partha is that he is very human. In my experience of speaking to at least 6 surgeons before finalising to go ahead with Dr Partha, he was the most polite surgeon who looked at patients as curious humans, spent lot of time pre surgery to explain what will be done, answered all queries, did 24x7 telephone counselling and also was the one himself and not his team, to attend to my father after the surgery.
I am writing this 4 months aftr the surgery and touch wood, my family is very happy and relaxed because of him
All surgeons do surgery, how many treat patients as humans is the question

featured_reviews.name: Kiran Jhamb
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am from Chhattisgarh and suddenly developed severe imbalance to the extent that I was unable to stand properly. On the advice of our family neuro physician, we immediately consulted Dr. Arvind Kulkarni, a highly reputed neurosurgeon known to us through successful surgeries of our acquaintances.
After examining me and reviewing my MRI, Dr. Kulkarni advised immediate surgery. We chose Breach Candy Hospital because of its excellent reputation. The surgery was successfully performed on 28th March, and throughout the entire process, we received exceptional care and guidance.
The hospital facilities, especially the Super Deluxe Room arrangements, were outstanding. The nursing staff, paramedical team, and housekeeping staff were extremely caring, courteous, and professional.
Dr. Kulkarni’s counseling, clarity of explanation, patience in answering every query, and reassuring approach before and after surgery were remarkable. I would also especially like to thank Dr. Janardhan, a wonderful doctor and compassionate human being, who closely monitored my recovery and explained every detail with great care and positivity.
Today, I am able to stand on my feet again, and for that, my heartfelt gratitude goes to Dr. Kulkarni, Dr. Janardhan, and the entire team of Breach Candy Hospital. We shall always remain grateful for the excellent treatment and humane care provided to us.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have updated my rating. The hospital staff took note of my feedback, and proactively resolved everything. Thank you.

featured_reviews.review_text: My mom had been admitted to the hospital in 2021 after an accident. She was in a private room till one day after her surgery. After that she was moved to the general ward. The nurses attending to her in the private room were kind and made sure she was comfortable. But the nurses at the general ward did not give a crap about her so much so that my mom peed in her bed. Luckily we got her out of there asap and she had to stay only overnight. Is Breach Candy only kind to the VIPs? We'll definitely go to a diff hospital next time.

featured_reviews.name: Azim Hannure
featured_reviews.review_text:
Breach Candy Hospital Trust, located in South Mumbai, is one of the city’s most reputed and well-established healthcare institutions. Known for its world-class medical facilities, advanced technology, and highly skilled team of doctors, it has been serving patients with excellence and compassion for decades. The hospital offers a wide range of specialties, including cardiology, oncology, orthopedics, neurology, pediatrics, and maternity care, all under one roof.

The infrastructure is modern and well-maintained, with clean and spacious rooms that ensure comfort and hygiene for patients and their families. The nursing staff is attentive, polite, and professional, providing round-the-clock care and support. The hospital is also known for its accurate diagnosis, efficient emergency services, and patient-centered approach, which builds great trust and confidence among visitors.

Breach Candy Hospital has a long-standing reputation for treating both Indian and international patients, thanks to its high medical standards and personalized treatment plans. While the charges may be slightly higher than average, the quality of service and medical expertise make it worth the cost. Overall, Breach Candy Hospital Trust stands out as a symbol of excellence in healthcare — a place where advanced medicine meets genuine care and dedication.

featured_reviews.name: Ash Bakhai
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a British citizen who has decided to under-go dental implants and cosmetic procedures, namely blepharoplasty and liposuction on neck, chest and stomach. I have chosen India as my preferred destination - a country with highly qualified medical professionals offering procedures at very attractive costs. To this end, I chose Indmed Travel (a Medical Tourism Company in Mumbai) as my intermediary                                        – a review of Indmed website and some background research gave me assurances in their expertise, to arrange and coordinate my requirements with the medical professionals based in Mumbai and Delhi.

Doctor Amogh was my coordinator at Indmed. He forwarded me a list of implantologists and cosmetic surgeons that complied with my criteria, namely medics with some international experiences/training and with proven track record of meeting patients’ expectations. I thoroughly reviewed the listing and from which I have selected medics, who I believe will successfully fulfill my expectations in due course.

To summarise, I feel very happy to have chosen Indmed as my medical intermediary - I believe they  are professional and customers focussed organisation. Furthermore, I found Doctor Amogh to be diligent, knowledgeable, excellent communicator and very attentive to my expectations and criteria’s.

featured_reviews.name: ashok mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Happy experience...
Thanks doctors....

Yes my friends,
People write many nasty experience they face in hospital or with doctors. Very few write their sweet experiences in hospital or with doctors.

So I thought to share my excellent sweet experience with a small, faraway hospital but with exceptional expertise in the field of knee replacement and other orthopedic and neurological complication.

My wife Operated for knee replacement on 15th...At 11 in the morning (to 2.30 pm) including recovery time inside operation theatre...

Then shifted to ICU.
Operation was good, my wife was in jolly mood and smiling while coming out from OT after the replacement ... But after 2 hrs of shifting to ICU, the real pain started... Wife was crying like mad for pain... But through medication by 8 pm it has started reducing... and she slept.
Nxt day, 16th, morning no pain...and shifted to pvt room cabin. I also staying in the same room with her. Excellent clean cosy room with all necessary requirements like AC, TV, eye catching view from 4th floor Window, attached very clean bath (no balcony), clean and daily fresh linen.

17th.. Sr Doctors and physiotherapist started her to walk and bent the new knee to 90°...

This was regular exercise, bending knee to 90° and walking in the corridor with the help of walker and physiotherapist till 19th...

And on 19th all bandage and all drain-pipes ( 3 in total... For Blood to drain our excess blood at operated knee, one for urine, one at spinal joint to push different medicine ) removed and....
discharged in the afternoon by doctor...
Same day, 19th, came to home by evening.

She is recovering nicely.... Walking inside the flat with the help of walker... pain she feel very very rarely.

After 9th day from operation, today (24th March) was the first check up...and it is absolutely OK.
Infact, my wife walk through out the day in hospital alone with the help of walker.
Today, she has been allowed by doctor to move and do morning/evening walk with walker and asked for further check up after 15 days.
No medicine given except multivitamin for further recovery as she has no pain.

We are very very happy for the excellent smooth operation, expertise of doctors, quick recovery process with effective treatment, support of Jr. Doctors, Physiotherapist, Metron, Sisters, Brothers, room boy and aayas for 24×7 and overall management of the hospital.

Well behaved people....
No extra billing...

We, and no one, before surgery, expected that after operation on 2nd day pain would vanish... she would walk and bend knee to 90°and get discharge on 4th day...!!!

All credit goes to Dr. Rahul Bade and his team including Anesthesists Dr. Ganesh Kolhe at Sparsh Multi-Speciality Hospital.

Thank you...well done, doctor !!!
🙏🙏🙏

Thanks to Lt. Col Dr Amogh Yadav from Mumbai and Dr. Rahul Mane for strongly recomanding us the hospital.

(Note : Treatment was going on at Sanchiti Hospital. But operated at Sparsh Multi Speciality Hospital)

featured_reviews.name: Sanaya Eranee
featured_reviews.review_text: On 18th June 2021 I went to Parsi General Hospital for my 1st dose Covishield vaccine. I was truly impressed with the way the entire process was undertaken - seamless and so well managed. I reached the Hospital at 8.30am and by exactly 8.58am I was vaccinated and seated in the wait area with a hot cup of tea given by the kind and hardworking staff. I wish to commend not only all the frontline workers, and the Team involved in this vaccination drive, but those nameless, silent faces of the Security, pantry boy and help staff all of whom went out of their way to help each and every person with courtesy, a big smile and the most polite demeanor. A Salute and Kudos to you all. I thank you very much and hope many people get to experience the wonder that is Parsi General Hospital.

I recently visited Bombay Hospital and while the doctor consultation was fine and I have no complaints regarding the medical treatment, my experience with the housekeeping staff was very disappointing.

featured_reviews.name: Hiren Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Feedback on My Hospitalisation Experience at Bombay Hospital

I have been admitted to Bombay Hospital on a few occasions in the past as well — not because I am fond of hospitals, but because my health conditions at times make it necessary.

During my recent admission on the 30th, of April 2026 I was initially admitted to the Critical Care ICCU on the 3rd floor. It was an extremely busy and demanding environment throughout the five nights I spent there, yet the overall dedication and efficiency of the staff stood out. Despite the pressure they work under, the doctors, nurses, and support staff carried out their responsibilities with sincerity and professionalism.

I have now been shifted to the Neuro ICCU on the 5th floor, and I would especially like to appreciate Senior Sister Jyoti and Senior Sister Surekha for the way they manage and maintain the unit. The ICCU is extremely well maintained, clean, organised, and disciplined. Their leadership reflects positively in the functioning of the entire team. The nursing staff has been warm, attentive, and committed towards patient care, and it is evident that they take pride in their duties.

Like every institution, minor flaws or occasional mistakes may happen, and there is always scope for improvement amongst some of the support staff, ward boys, ward girls, and helping staff. However, it is equally important to acknowledge the larger picture — the effort, compassion, and dedication shown daily by the nursing teams and medical staff under challenging circumstances.

Over the years, I have personally seen many nurses grow from trainees into confident and capable professionals handling immense responsibilities with maturity and experience. That growth deserves appreciation and encouragement.

I sincerely wish the entire team continued success and growth in their careers. May they keep evolving, learning, and rising further in their profession while continuing to provide compassionate care to patients and families who depend on them during difficult times.

I remain grateful and thankful for the care and support extended to me.

Hiren Mehta
Bed No. 5073
Neuro ICCU
Bombay Hospital
